fun_fact: The world just crossed 3 terawatts of installed solar power — and almost no one noticed. The first terawatt took a decade to build; the third was added in under two years. From rooftops to floating farms, solar is scaling faster than any energy source in history. [Read more](https://www.energyconnects.com/news/renewables/2026/august/the-world-crossed-a-major-solar-milestone-no-one-noticed/)
